method_definition: For the same native boundary object as the visibility mask, read the mesh-instance OBB from the .house O record in the frozen instance lookup. Reconstruct axis2 = axis0 cross axis1; require one vertical and two horizontal axes in native Z-up coordinates. Object span = twice the larger horizontal OBB radius. These are full extents, not radii or an XY axis-aligned diagonal.
